boundaries: Focus on currency basis, valuation timing, period/frequency conventions and deterministic cash-flow definitions.
Distinguish effective from nominal rates, annual from monthly periods, real from nominal amounts, incremental from total cost, and beginning- from end-of-period timing.
No assumed current market rates, taxes, investment returns, inflation forecasts or asset recommendations.
Do not resubmit uniform-present-value@source-3 unchanged; annuity-due or growing variants only if mathematically distinct with their own sources.
Probabilistic risk, option pricing and econometric estimation are excluded; textbook identities and closed forms only.
coverage_guidance: Priorities are seeds, not a finite checklist. Continue into adjacent source chapters/subtopics inside the boundaries, selecting independently reusable relationships. Save multiple bounded batches without waiting for owner review. Check supplied inventory and prior returns for equivalent relationships and conflicting IDs. Record out-of-format discoveries as deferred with exact sources and missing capabilities; do not force chains or dilute quality for a quota.
integration_expectation: Currency, dimensionless and period-count dimensions fit the current profile, but most records still need new meanings (future_value, periodic_payment, effective_rate, nominal_rate, growth_rate, inflation_rate) and must be marked requires-extension with a runtime_model sketch where the scalar form is supported. A generic future payment is not annual_saving and a recovery amount is not operating_cost. The engine supports + - * / ** only: closed forms only, no iterative solvers.
mission: Curate atomic, reusable time-value-of-money relationships: future value, annuities, loan amortization, rate conversions and growth models, each with explicit timing, frequency and price conventions. Continue through successive review batches during the sustained session; no heating use case or connected chain is required. This is mathematical formalization, not investment advice or forecasting.
priorities: Future value of a lump sum with stated compounding frequency
Level loan/mortgage periodic payment (amortization) for a positive rate, with timing convention explicit
Effective annual rate from a nominal rate and compounding frequency
Constant-growth (Gordon) present value with the growth-below-rate guard explicit
Real/nominal rate conversion (Fisher relationship) with clearly scoped inflation meaning
special_checks: Independently sum individual discounted cash flows for annuity/loan references instead of repeating the closed form
Test the rate-approaching-zero boundary explicitly as a separate branch or limit; never silently substitute a different rate convention
Timing (beginning vs end of period) must be stated in the record and reflected in guards
Never mix nominal and real quantities in one expression
starter_sources: Find an accessible engineering-economy textbook (for example Newnan, or Blank and Tarquin) or agency reference for amortization, rate conversion and growth models; starter links alone do not prove the equation
title: Engineering finance: time-value-of-money family and loan arithmetic
